item.title: Can 'Pre-Bunking' Help Combat the Health Misinformation Infodemic?
item.description: A growing number of health professionals are exploring pre-bunking as a way to counter public mistrust in medicine and science.

item.title: Review Finds Exercise Offers Minimal Benefits for Hip Osteoarthritis
item.description: Exercise may slightly reduce pain and improve function in hip osteoarthritis, but the effects may be limited compared to no treatment.

item.title: Two Neural Pathways Explain How Habits Form and Vary in Intensity
item.description: Habit formation involves a shift from deliberate to automatic decision-making, with two neural pathways influencing how strongly habits develop.

item.title: Emergency Physician Burnout: 1 in 10 Leaving Specialty in Canada
item.description: Burnout is driving emergency physicians to leave the specialty or reduce hours, highlighting a crisis in healthcare workforce retention.
